rationale: Build on the current best late-aligned decoder-skip baseline, but shift the recurrent replay anchor instead of another small control sweep. Each repeated tail block now reuses its own first-pass pre-block activation, captured after the winning late skip injection, so the recurrent pass refines the same late-skip-conditioned state instead of always anchoring back to the root embedding. This stays compile-stable, byte-neutral, and preserves the existing quant-aware/export path.
title: First-Pass Input Anchors For Recurrent Tail
